headline: Country Offers 2.5 Million TL Reward per Child as It Grows Very Old
summary: Singapore announced a child support package exceeding 55,000 dollars per child to address record-low birth rates and an aging population. Parental leave will be expanded and housing access eased.
why: Singapore is a wealthy city-state whose labor force growth and fiscal spending depend heavily on demographics and immigration policy.
